+"""PAT repository discovery, adapted from secman_ai_github's GitHub client.
+
+This module lists metadata only. Cloning and source review have separate entry points.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import os
+import re
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Iterator
+
+
+class RepositoryError(Exception):
+    """An operator-facing error that contains no credentials or raw API response."""
+
+
+def validate_full_name(value: str) -> str:
+    owner, separator, name = value.partition("/")
+    if (
+        not separator
+        or not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9-]*", owner)
+        or not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+", name)
+        or name in (".", "..")
+    ):
+        raise RepositoryError("repository must have the form owner/name")
+    return value
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class RepoInfo:
+    owner: str
+    name: str
+    full_name: str
+    archived: bool
+    fork: bool
+    size_kb: int
+    default_branch: str
+    clone_url: str
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        validate_full_name(self.full_name)
+        if self.full_name != f"{self.owner}/{self.name}":
+            raise RepositoryError("inconsistent repository identity")
+        if self.clone_url != f"https://github.com/{self.full_name}.git":
+            raise RepositoryError("clone URL must match the repository on https://github.com")
+
+    @classmethod
+    def from_github_repo(cls, repo) -> RepoInfo:
+        return cls(
+            owner=repo.owner.login,
+            name=repo.name,
+            full_name=repo.full_name,
+            archived=bool(repo.archived),
+            fork=bool(repo.fork),
+            size_kb=int(repo.size or 0),
+            default_branch=repo.default_branch or "",
+            clone_url=repo.clone_url,
+        )
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Filters:
+    include_archived: bool = False
+    include_forks: bool = False
+    max_size_mb: int = 500
+
+
+def should_include(repo: RepoInfo, filters: Filters, org: str | None = None) -> bool:
+    """Same owner, archive, fork and size predicate as secman_ai_github."""
+    if org and repo.owner.lower() != org.lower():
+        return False
+    if repo.archived and not filters.include_archived:
+        return False
+    if repo.fork and not filters.include_forks:
+        return False
+    if filters.max_size_mb > 0 and repo.size_kb / 1024 > filters.max_size_mb:
+        return False
+    return True
+
+
+class GithubPatClient:
+    """Lazy PyGithub authentication and paginated PAT-scoped enumeration."""
+
+    def __init__(self, token: str):
+        if not token or any(character.isspace() for character in token):
+            raise RepositoryError("GITHUB_TOKEN must contain a non-empty access token")
+        self._token = token
+        self._gh = None
+
+    @classmethod
+    def from_env(cls) -> GithubPatClient:
+        return cls(os.environ.get("GITHUB_TOKEN", ""))
+
+    @property
+    def gh(self):
+        if self._gh is None:
+            try:
+                from github import Auth, Github
+            except ImportError:
+                raise RepositoryError("install GitHub support: pip install -e '.[github]'") from None
+            self._gh = Github(
+                auth=Auth.Token(self._token), base_url="https://api.github.com",
+                per_page=100, timeout=30, retry=2,
+            )
+        return self._gh
+
+    def iter_repositories(
+        self, org: str | None = None, filters: Filters | None = None,
+        repositories: list[str] | None = None,
+    ) -> Iterator[RepoInfo]:
+        gh = self.gh
+        from github import GithubException
+        from requests import RequestException
+
+        filters = filters or Filters()
+        try:
+            raw_repos = (
+                (gh.get_repo(validate_full_name(name)) for name in repositories)
+                if repositories else gh.get_user().get_repos()
+            )
+            seen = set()
+            for repo in raw_repos:
+                info = RepoInfo.from_github_repo(repo)
+                key = info.full_name.lower()
+                if key not in seen and should_include(info, filters, org):
+                    seen.add(key)
+                    yield info
+        except GithubException as exc:
+            raise RepositoryError(
+                f"GitHub request failed (HTTP {exc.status}); check token permissions, "
+                "organization SSO authorization and rate limits"
+            ) from None
+        except RequestException:
+            raise RepositoryError("GitHub connection failed; check network and TLS settings") from None
+
+    def close(self) -> None:
+        if self._gh is not None:
+            self._gh.close()

+"""Shallow cloning adapted from secman_ai_github, preserving existing directories."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import base64
+import os
+import subprocess
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from .github_repos import RepoInfo, RepositoryError
+
+
+def build_clone_command(url: str, dest: Path) -> list[str]:
+    return ["git", "clone", "--depth", "1", "--no-tags", "--single-branch", "--", url, str(dest)]
+
+
+def _auth_env(token: str) -> dict[str, str]:
+    """Pass the header only to this process, scoped to GitHub's HTTPS origin."""
+    basic = base64.b64encode(f"x-access-token:{token}".encode()).decode()
+    config = {
+        "http.https://github.com/.extraheader": f"Authorization: Basic {basic}",
+        "http.followRedirects": "false",
+        "credential.helper": "",
+        "core.hooksPath": os.devnull,
+        "init.templateDir": "",
+        "core.fsmonitor": "false",
+        "protocol.allow": "never",
+        "protocol.https.allow": "always",
+    }
+    env = {"GIT_CONFIG_COUNT": str(len(config))}
+    for index, (key, value) in enumerate(config.items()):
+        env[f"GIT_CONFIG_KEY_{index}"] = key
+        env[f"GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_{index}"] = value
+    return env
+
+
+def clone_repo(repo: RepoInfo, token: str, dest_root: Path) -> Path:
+    """Clone to root/owner/name, refusing existing paths, including symlinks.
+
+    Failed or interrupted clones are retained for the operator to inspect. Never
+    delete a path automatically: a directory name does not prove ownership.
+    """
+    root = dest_root.resolve()
+    owner = root / repo.owner
+    owner.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    if owner.is_symlink() or owner.resolve().parent != root:
+        raise RepositoryError("clone owner directory must stay inside the destination")
+    dest = owner / repo.name
+    try:
+        dest.mkdir()
+    except FileExistsError:
+        raise RepositoryError(f"destination already exists for {repo.full_name}; preserved") from None
+
+    # Do not inherit Git tracing, config overrides, or unrelated service credentials.
+    allowed = {
+        "PATH", "HOME", "SYSTEMROOT", "TMPDIR", "TEMP", "TMP", "LANG", "LC_ALL",
+        "HTTPS_PROXY", "HTTP_PROXY", "ALL_PROXY", "NO_PROXY",
+        "https_proxy", "http_proxy", "all_proxy", "no_proxy",
+        "SSL_CERT_FILE", "SSL_CERT_DIR", "GIT_SSL_CAINFO", "GIT_SSL_CAPATH",
+    }
+    env = {key: value for key, value in os.environ.items() if key in allowed}
+    env.update({
+        "GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT": "0", "GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM": "1",
+        "GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL": os.devnull, **_auth_env(token),
+    })
+    try:
+        result = subprocess.run(
+            build_clone_command(repo.clone_url, dest), env=env,
+            stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL, timeout=300,
+        )
+    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
+        raise RepositoryError(f"clone timed out for {repo.full_name}; destination retained") from None
+    except OSError:
+        raise RepositoryError(f"cannot start git for {repo.full_name}; check Git installation") from None
+    if result.returncode:
+        raise RepositoryError(
+            f"clone failed for {repo.full_name} (git exit {result.returncode}); "
+            "check access, network and disk space; destination retained"
+        )
+    return dest

+"""Separate repository acquisition command; never imports or invokes a scanner."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import os
+import sys
+from dataclasses import asdict
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from .github_repos import Filters, GithubPatClient, RepositoryError, validate_full_name
+from .repo_cloner import clone_repo
+
+
+def parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
+    result = argparse.ArgumentParser(
+        prog="secman-repos", description="List or clone GitHub repositories using GITHUB_TOKEN",
+    )
+    commands = result.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
+    for command in ("list", "clone"):
+        sub = commands.add_parser(command, help=f"{command} token-accessible repositories")
+        sub.add_argument("--org", help="filter by owner/organization (case-insensitive)")
+        sub.add_argument("--repo", action="append", help="select owner/name; repeat for more repos")
+        sub.add_argument("--include-archived", action="store_true")
+        sub.add_argument("--include-forks", action="store_true")
+        sub.add_argument("--max-size-mb", type=int, default=500, help="size cap (default: 500; 0: none)")
+        sub.add_argument("--format", choices=("text", "json"), default="text")
+        if command == "clone":
+            sub.add_argument("--destination", type=Path, required=True, help="clone under this directory")
+    return result
+
+
+def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
+    args = parser().parse_args(argv)
+    if args.max_size_mb < 0:
+        print("error: --max-size-mb must be zero or positive", file=sys.stderr)
+        return 2
+    client = None
+    try:
+        for name in args.repo or []:
+            validate_full_name(name)
+        client = GithubPatClient.from_env()
+        repos = list(client.iter_repositories(
+            org=args.org, filters=Filters(
+                args.include_archived, args.include_forks, args.max_size_mb,
+            ), repositories=args.repo,
+        ))
+        records = []
+        failed = False
+        for repo in repos:
+            record = asdict(repo)
+            if args.command == "clone":
+                try:
+                    record["local_path"] = str(clone_repo(
+                        repo, os.environ["GITHUB_TOKEN"], args.destination,
+                    ))
+                except (RepositoryError, OSError) as exc:
+                    # Raw OS/transport errors can contain paths or credentials.
+                    message = str(exc) if isinstance(exc, RepositoryError) else "filesystem error"
+                    print(f"error: {repo.full_name}: {message}", file=sys.stderr)
+                    failed = True
+                    continue
+            records.append(record)
+        if args.format == "json":
+            print(json.dumps(records, indent=2))
+        else:
+            for record in records:
+                fields = [record["full_name"], f"{record['size_kb']} KB", record["default_branch"]]
+                if "local_path" in record:

+    except RepositoryError as exc:

+        return 1

 Overrides are parsed as argument lists and invoked without a shell. Files are placed in the

 handling policies before sending proprietary code to any hosted model.
+
+## List and clone GitHub repositories
+
+`secman-repos` acquires repositories; `secman` scans local source. They are separate
+commands. Listing and cloning never start an AI agent or send findings anywhere.
+
+Supply `GITHUB_TOKEN` through your secret manager (for example, `pass-cli`) in the
+command's environment. There is deliberately no token command-line option. The
+initial version supports GitHub.com personal access tokens, including fine-grained
+tokens; GitHub App authentication and Enterprise hosts are outside this version's scope.
+
+The token must allow access to the repositories you want to list, and read access
+to their contents to clone private repositories. Organization policies and SSO may
+require separate authorization. Results reflect the token's access, so a successful
+listing does not prove that every repository in an organization is covered. Listing
+uses the authenticated user's paginated repository API, as in `secman_ai_github`.
+
+```bash
+# List accessible repositories, then narrow to one owner/organization
+secman-repos list
+secman-repos list --org my-org
+
+# Machine-readable inventory (metadata only; no local files are created)
+secman-repos list --org my-org --format json
+
+# Clone one selected repository, or every repository passing the filters
+secman-repos clone --repo my-org/service --destination ./checkouts
+secman-repos clone --org my-org --destination ./checkouts --format json
+
+# Scan a clone explicitly using the existing tool
+secman ./checkouts/my-org/service
+```
+
+Both subcommands accept repeated `--repo owner/name` selections. Explicit selections
+are looked up directly; `--org` and the other filters still apply. By default,
+archived repositories, forks, and repositories larger than 500 MB (GitHub's reported
+size) are excluded. Use `--include-archived`, `--include-forks`, and `--max-size-mb 0`
+to include them. The size filter is metadata-based, not a limit on downloaded bytes.
+
+Text output contains tab-separated name, size in KB, and default branch; cloning
+adds the absolute checkout path. JSON is an array of repository metadata; successful
+clones add `local_path`. An empty selection produces no text rows or `[]` in JSON.
+
+Cloning requires Git 2.31 or newer. It makes shallow, single-branch clones of the
+remote default branch with no tags or submodules, under `destination/owner/name`.
+Existing paths, including empty directories and symlinks, are refused and preserved.
+A clone failure is reported on stderr; other selected repositories are still attempted,
+and stdout contains only successful clones. Failed or interrupted destinations may
+remain; inspect them manually or choose another destination before retrying.
+
+The clone token is passed through a process-only Git HTTP authorization header,
+scoped to `https://github.com/`. It is never put in arguments, clone URLs, output,
+or saved Git configuration. Redirects, credential helpers, Git hooks, and inherited
+Git configuration/tracing are disabled for cloning. Git errors report a safe summary
+instead of raw transport output. Each Git clone has a five-minute timeout.
+
+The PAT client, metadata mapping, archive/fork/size filters, shallow-clone options,
+and environment-based authentication were adapted from `secman_ai_github`'s
+`github_auth.py`, `github_app.py`, `config.py`, and `cloner.py`. This is a standalone
+copy of the relevant functionality and does not import that repository or its scanner.

+python -m pytest
+```

Added **`secman-repos`** to `secman_source`, using the PAT authentication, repository mapping, filters, and cloning approach from `secman_ai_github`.

You now have two separate tools:

- **`secman-repos list` / `secman-repos clone`** — discover and acquire GitHub repositories.
- **`secman <path>`** — scan local source with the existing AI scanner.

The new tool supports owner/organization filtering, repeated `--repo owner/name` selections, and text or JSON output. It reads `GITHUB_TOKEN` from the environment. Cloning creates shallow checkouts under `destination/owner/repository` and preserves existing destinations. Tokens stay out of command arguments, output, and saved Git configuration.

A dedicated `.venv` is installed and ready to use. With `GITHUB_TOKEN` supplied through your secret manager:

```bash
cd /Users/flake/sources/misc/secman/extensions/secman_source
source .venv/bin/activate

# List repositories
secman-repos list --org my-org --format json

# Clone one repository
secman-repos clone --repo my-org/service --destination ./checkouts

# Scan it separately
secman ./checkouts/my-org/service
```

The initial version supports **GitHub.com personal access tokens**, including fine-grained tokens. Archived repositories, forks, and repositories larger than 500 MB are excluded by default; the override flags and installation instructions are in the [README](/Users/flake/sources/misc/secman/extensions/secman_source/README.md:76). Repository visibility depends on the token’s permissions. See [GitHub’s repository API documentation](https://docs.github.com/en/rest/repos/repos#list-repositories-for-the-authenticated-user).

Verification completed:

- **52 tests passed**, covering pagination, selection, failures, destination preservation, token handling, and separation from scanning.
- Lint, wheel build, installed-command checks, and OWASP static checks passed.
- JavaScript E2E: **74 clean pages for each role**, with zero errors, timeouts, or expired sessions.
- Vulnerability/exception E2E passed, including consecutive cleanup/idempotency runs on a disposable stack.

OWASP A01–A10 reviewed: no unresolved findings in this change. Live GitHub access was not tested with a real token; verification used mocked API responses and a real local Git clone.
